verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and APIs, presented as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI. Clients only need to point at api.fireworks.ai, and tool calling uses OpenAI-compatible tool specifications. A Create Chat Completion reference and an Anthropic-messages OpenAPI spec further support swapping providers without provider-specific code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents switch mid-workflow without code changes, and documentation of any parameter-compatibility gaps beyond model-ID changes.
